name: crc32
description: CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3) checksum of text, as 8 lowercase hex digits (C). WHEN TO USE: a cheap integrity check or cache-busting key where a full cryptographic hash (ck_hash) is overkill. Input: {"text": "..."}; the text may also be passed bare, unwrapped.
llm_description: CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3) checksum of text as 8 lowercase hex digits. Cheap integrity/cache-key check; use ck_hash for a cryptographic hash. {text} (or bare text).
